data.name: Sukhdev
data.gender_notes: Sukhdev is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sukh means happiness and dev means god. Thus, Sukhdev is the god of happiness. The name Sukhdev carries the meaning “God of happiness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sukhdev usually hope their child will grow to embody god of happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sukhdev is the embodiment of happiness and joy. He is believed to bring happiness and positivity in one's life.
data.etymology: Sukhdev belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of happiness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sukhdev total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: Sukhdev is a common name among Hindus, often given to children to bless them with a happy and joyful life. In Indian culture and folklore, Sukhdev is often depicted as ahelper and devoted friend of Bhagat Singh Bhil, a legendary chieftain of the Meena tribe who is known for his bravery and dedication to justice. The friendship between Sukhdev and Bhagat Singh is celebrated as a sacred bond and an example of selflessness and loyalty.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sukhdev holds great spiritual significance for Hindus, as it is considered to be a reminder of the divine presence of happiness and joy in one's life. The name is believed to bestow blessings of contentment, peace, and inner happiness upon the bearer. Sukhdev is also seen as an embodiment of the divine principle of selflessness and devotion, inspiring individuals to cultivate these qualities within themselves and to serve others with an open heart.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sukhdev: One who embodies joy and contentment, devoted to Lord Krishna, radiating happiness and inner peace.

historical_references.reference: Sukhdev was a companion of Bhagat Singh and Shivaram Rajguru, who were executed for their involvement in the assassination of British Police Superintendent John Saunders in 1928.
Sukhdev was also a significant figure in the Khalsa Panth, a Sikh religious and political organization, and is considered a martyr for his role in the Battle of Bhangani in 1657.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Radha Sukhdev in Hyderabad, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Sukhdev, which means "God of happiness". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
